mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM factory_profile WHERE id IN #{id}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(template_version),0)+1 FROM coupon_template WHERE template_code=#{code}
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon_template SET template_name=#{input.templateName},coupon_type=#{input.couponType}, face_amount_fen=#{input.faceAmountFen},discount_rate_bps=#{input.discountRateBps},threshold_rent_amount_fen=#{input.thresholdRentAmountFen}, applicable_scope_type=#{input.applicableScopeType},validity_type=#{input.validityType},valid_days=#{input.validDays}, valid_start_at=#{input.startLocal},valid_end_at=#{input.endLocal},updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND template_status='draft'

UPDATE coupon_distribution SET template_id=#{input.templateId},config_json=JSON_OBJECT('schema_version',1,'condition',#{input.condition},'reason',#{input.reason}), starts_at=#{input.startLocal},ends_at=#{input.endLocal},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{input.version} AND status='draft'
UPDATE coupon_distribution SET status=#{status},version=version+1,published_at=IF(#{status}='active',#{at},published_at) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(rule_version),0)+1 FROM coupon_reward_rule WHERE event_type=#{event}
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon_reward_rule SET template_id=#{templateId} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='draft'
UPDATE coupon_reward_rule SET status='ended',ended_at=#{at} WHERE event_type=#{event} AND status='active'
